action_training.action_loss_denominator: mean over the logical batch of all 8 x 7 action targets
action_training.input_and_output_contract: Same front/wrist RGB, state, preprocessing, action/state normalizers, predict-eight/execute-eight, 20 Hz as B0.
action_training.new_module_optimizer_and_loss_weights: Must be declared per method before production; matched across corresponding Pixel/JEPA and auxiliary/coupled comparisons.

authorization: User accepted two total action-training epochs and requested unchanged effective batch size and sampling.

batching_and_sampling.future_target_handling: Attach future targets to fixed action anchors; use predeclared masks for unavailable horizons, preserving every action sample.
batching_and_sampling.short_batches: Retain exact B0 per-update sample counts; no padding, dropping, merging or oversampling.

claim_limits: Equal action epochs and batches do not imply equal total compute.
CPT/event exposure and extra trainable parameters must be reported separately.
Do not claim all future architectures are profiled or guaranteed to fit.

compute_plan.b0_memory_measurement_scope: Maximum logged allocated tensor memory; excludes allocator-reserved, driver/context and other processes.
compute_plan.feasibility: Expected for lightweight CPT and M1/M2; conditional on architecture pilots for M3/M4 and EventGround. No new-model memory or throughput measurements yet.
compute_plan.prospective_design: Small deterministic Pixel/JEPA predictors, bounded future tokens, BF16, LoRA, activation checkpointing, optional accumulation and bounded frozen-feature caches.
required_per_model_pilot: Full forward/backward/optimizer peak allocated/reserved and device-level memory
Steady throughput and projected endpoint time

gradient_accumulation.future_losses: Use logical-batch valid-target denominators; batch-dependent regularizers require logical-batch statistics.
gradient_accumulation.optimizer_scheduler_and_clipping: Once per original logical batch, after all microbatches.
pilot_requirements: Compare full-batch and accumulated loss/gradients within predeclared numerical tolerance
gradient_accumulation.recovery: Checkpoint complete optimizer boundaries or explicitly persist partial accumulated gradients and cursor.

initialization.future_modules: M1/M3 share C_pixel; M2/M4 share C_jepa. CPT begins from pinned base representations; no silent B0 teacher or trained B0 weights.
initialization.optimizer: Fresh AdamW/scheduler for every core policy arm.
initialization.shared_policy_components: Fresh OFT action head, state projector and broad rank-32 LoRA as in the completed B0 run; verify shared initial tensors before adding independently seeded future modules.

scope.M4_EG: Inherits two action epochs from M4; event SFT/RLVR separately budgeted; no extra action updates authorized by this contract.
scope.cpt: Separate matched Pixel/JEPA future-pair training budget, not counted as action epochs.

preserves: All measured outcomes, rules and scientific gate statuses
Selected B0 checkpoint as the evaluation control
replaces: Initialize all later policies from trained epoch-2 B0
Require an additional action-only B0 continuation for the core matrix
